Huevia 0.11.1-beta (versionCode 58)

Delivered behavior:
- Manual preset application shows overall progress, current image and processing stage.
- Live automatic presets show stage/percentage in a fixed-height region and on the active tile.
- Photo Live project, hero and virtualized three-column photo rows scroll together.
  Byte/status events preserve the current viewport; a compact top action returns to the header.
- Export distinguishes JPG current version from the camera's unchanged original NEF.
  Separate RAW camera/saved lists, bounded paging, serial batch export and retry are provided.
  Direct MediaStore saving uses the original bytes; no file destination picker or JPEG-to-RAW conversion.
- NEF/JPEG pairing requires trusted camera/provenance and an unambiguous complete inventory.
  Older JPEGs without that evidence or ambiguous candidates require explicit RAW selection.
  New camera RAW reading requires stopping Photo Live; saved RAW publication works offline.
- Online NCP and supported NP3 recipes render the current template without joining My Presets.
  Visible work is bounded; unsupported recipes have an explicit reason and no false effect image.
- Process-owned preset downloads show actual byte progress or a named unknown-length stage.
  Reopening a page retains active state; library revision events synchronize Activity replacement.
- Local preset detail and card long-press allow confirmed deletion. Project default references
  are checked again before removal. Active work blocks removal; persisted tombstones prevent
  legacy migration revival. Camera slots, original/effect photos and unrelated/external samples stay intact.

Frozen-APK native verification, emulator-5560, Android 17 / API 37:
- Online preview/download/delete: light portrait 75 PASS; dark portrait 75 PASS;
  light landscape 76 PASS. Real NCP and supported/unsupported NP3 fixtures, Android pixels,
  hold-original, fixed layout, bounded queues, offline cache, unknown sample phase, leave/reenter,
  duplicate suppression, deletion confirmation and file-backed library reopen are covered.
  Evidence: docs/validation/online-preview-58/README.md (24 reviewed screenshots).
- Live scrolling/preset progress/RAW: light portrait 249 PASS; dark portrait 208 PASS.
  Actual touch scroll, header recycling, return to top, visible-row bounds, anchor preservation,
  selection/star/viewer behavior, injected progress states and export-format semantics are covered.
- One owned 33554432-byte synthetic TIFF/EP NEF passed actual RawPhotoStore -> RawPhotoPanel ->
  Android MediaStore: MIME image/x-nikon-nef, exact full SHA/length, repeat same URI, immediate
  photo service lease, observed background operation and completion lease release.
- Final portrait reports confirm owned fixture cleanup. Helpers were independently built;
  preliminary helper failures concerned touch coordinates, recycled-header geometry and Android
  canonical path aliases. They did not require a product change after the final build.
- Live landscape captured screenshots but stopped at the first drag assertion because the
  helper's central touch region overlapped the floating navigation. It is NOT a passed landscape
  scrolling test. The existing tall fixed app header also constrains landscape content height.
  Evidence: .impeccable/review/preset-progress-raw-0.11.1/README.md, including history and limits.

Publication:
- Published to the beta channel through the authenticated version-management API.
- Public APK full byte count and SHA-256 match this signed artifact; latest beta metadata matches 58.
- Download: https://nikon-d8girdjsr252fd90e-1252602548.ap-shanghai.app.tcloudbase.com/preset-library/download/?channel=beta
- No backend deployment, schema migration or administrator credentials embedded in the client.

Limits:
- No physical phone installation or real-camera NEF transfer was performed in this task.
- Synthetic NEF/PTP/MediaStore tests do not establish Nikon model/firmware compatibility or OEM gallery decoding.
- RAW is preserved original data, with no phone-preset RAW development. Automatic live reception stays JPEG.
- Phone template rendering remains approximate; unsupported NP3 variants and NP3 camera import remain blocked.
- No new long-running camera/background/lock-screen, physical gesture performance or TalkBack certification.
